questions.question: In SQL, what is the exact difference between the window functions `ROW_NUMBER()`, `RANK()`, and `DENSE_RANK()` when evaluating tied values?

options.A: ROW_NUMBER assigns unique sequential integers regardless of ties; RANK assigns equal numbers to ties and skips subsequent ranks; DENSE_RANK assigns equal numbers to ties without skipping subsequent ranks.
options.B: RANK skips ranks, but ROW_NUMBER and DENSE_RANK are identical.
options.C: DENSE_RANK only operates on grouped rows with HAVING clauses.
options.D: ROW_NUMBER can only be used with PostgreSQL, not SQL Server.

questions.question: In statistics and hypothesis testing for A/B experiments, what is a Type I error (Alpha) vs a Type II error (Beta)?

options.B: Type I is a false negative; Type II is a false positive.
options.C: Type I occurs when sample size is too large; Type II occurs when sample size is too small.
options.D: Type I relates to median; Type II relates to standard deviation.
